subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The OWASP Top Ten
description: A quick, practical guide to The OWASP Top Ten.

hook.text: Ten vulnerability categories cause the vast majority of web application breaches. They're well documented.

buildup.text: OWASP publishes a regularly updated list of the most critical web application security risks.

discovery.text: The list includes injection, broken authentication, sensitive data exposure, and misconfiguration.

twist.text: The same ten categories have dominated for over a decade. Most breaches exploit well-known problems.

climax.text: Teams that systematically test against the OWASP Top Ten catch 80% of common attack vectors.

punchline.text: The threats are known. The defenses exist. Just test for them.

quiz.question: What does the OWASP Top Ten list?
